priority_recommendations.recommendation: Exact reuse Copenhagen and Helsinki for both partners; retain all inherited canonical routes and do not duplicate IDs.
Add a review-gated Trondheim city layer inside norway for the shared Dott/Voi exact row; ground the three AtB terminals, then seal only the two official Trondheimfjord candidates.

Repair existing reuse before minting: Porvoo River Quay/7 routes need a Porvoo city attribution; Askøy/Kleppestø/7 routes need an Askøy city attribution; Knarvik remains P1 until its name-only BP resolves.
Use the shared Dott/Voi Tampere row as a narrow lake-system exception; candidate only Laukontori–Viikinsaari, not inland Finland bulk.
Add Aalborg–Egholm and Turku waterbus briefs/BPs only after canonical stop-name and point verification.
Hold remaining coastal rows as the research queue. Do not bulk-mint Denmark metro municipalities, Finland coast, southern Norway or Voi-only Sweden without named BP systems.

risks_and_holds: Partner city/country evidence proves current micromobility presence, not pickup at any pier or demand for a water route.
Broad country clusters span distinct hydrological systems. Membership must not be presented as exact partner service at every cluster city.
All proposed city identifiers and all candidate BPs/routes are not_banked; no coordinates or route IDs were created.
Porvoo, Askøy and Knarvik routes are globally banked but use broader Helsinki/Bergen city attribution; careless rewiring could change cross-city semantics or route QA.
Tampere is an intentional shared-partner navigable-lake exception, not authorization for inland Finland bulk coverage.
Aalborg municipality names the ferry service and function of the landings; canonical local landing names and coordinates still require seal-time verification.
The Turku waterbus stop pattern can run via Ruissalo shipyard or Pikisaari; verify the selected 2026 pattern before geometry.
Dott exited Sweden in 2025. The conflicted Gothenburg row must not activate Dott Sweden; Voi remains the only current partner in this lane.
Existing norway contains one quarantined route; this handoff does not change or certify route QA.
